## 1. Executive Summary & Philosophy
"All entity have problems, but problems are seeds for enlightenment." — Peter Lodri
"Life is God's goods and we all are its little buddhas." — Peter Lodri

The vaked.dev ecosystem is an autonomous, decentralized computing fabric spanning 13 specialized nodes and sovereign toolchains. Built from first principles on NixOS, Metal, WebAssembly, Swift 6, and Rust, the constellation provides complete sovereign independence across inference, memory, mathematical research, security defense, creative expression, and decentralized attestation.

## 3. Deep Technical Architecture

### 3.1 MagiSCanner (`8bit-wraith/magiscanner`)
- **Supply-Chain Hardening**: Automated scanning of dependencies, build scripts, and MCP hooks to detect and neutralize prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and poisoned packages.
- **Hash Integrity Memory**: SQLite hash registry providing sub-millisecond tamper detection across repository state.
- **Certificate Trust Neutralizer**: Identifies and quarantines compromised TLS roots and untrusted cryptographic primitives.

### 3.2 Smart-Tree (`8b-is/smart-tree`)
- **AST Parsing**: Parallel syn/tree-sitter AST extraction mapping function signatures, structs, and dependency call paths without token waste.
- **Quantum Compression**: Recursive context compaction (`st --mode quantum`) packing directory trees into token-efficient LLM prompts.
- **MEM8 Archaeology**: Git commit hash state persistence with semantic wave recall.

### 3.3 Transformers-Ultra (`8b-is/transformers`)
- **RoPE Guarding**: Mathematical block-diagonal rotation operator R_Θ,m applied strictly to the head dimension slice d_k = d_head without reshaping or allocations.
- **AST Optimization**: Eliminated runtime python dynamic signature reflection, yielding >2.2x speedup on token generation loops.

### 3.4 MEM8 Wave Memory Core
- **Cognitive Bands**: Gamma (8Hz), Beta (4Hz), Alpha (2Hz), Theta (1Hz).
- **Recall Algorithm**: Continuous cosine spectral resonance similarity S(u, v) = (u · v) / (||u|| ||v||) over harmonic carrier waves.

## 4. Machine APIs & Interfaces

- **MagiSCanner MCP**: `magiscanner --mcp` (Security Sentinel JSON-RPC protocol)
- **Smart-Tree MCP**: `st --mcp` (Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC standard)
- **8b.is Documentation Hub**: `https://www.8b.is/documentation`
- **8b-Public-Documents**: `https://github.com/8b-is/8b-public-documents`
- **OpenAI-Compatible Gateway**: `POST https://ocean.vaked.dev/v1/chat/completions`
- **MEM8 Memory Recall**: `POST https://ocean.vaked.dev/api/v1/memory/recall`
- **Agent Factory Scheduler**: `POST https://ocean.vaked.dev/api/v1/agents/spawn`
- **Fleet Feed (JSON)**: `GET https://worklog.vaked.dev/feed.json`
- **Fleet Feed (RSS)**: `GET https://worklog.vaked.dev/feed.xml`
- **Skills Registry**: `GET https://vaked.dev/.well-known/skills/index.json`
